title: Sunday Worship Service
description: Join us for our weekly worship gathering with praise, prayer, Scripture reading, and teaching from God's Word.

title: Sunday Fellowship and Refreshments
description: A time for the community to share refreshments and strengthen bonds of fellowship.

title: Monthly Prayer and Fasting
description: Gather together for corporate prayer, testimony, reflection, and intercession for our community.

title: Missions/Deacon Team Meeting
description: Regular meetings for missions and deacon teams to coordinate outreach activities and ministry planning.

title: Church Anniversary Celebration
description: Celebrating the establishment of First Naga Baptist Church with special worship, guest speakers, and remembrance of God's faithfulness.

title: Fellowship with Baylor Students
description: Join us for a special Sunday with Baylor Naga student-led worship service, followed by fellowship and a delicious potluck meal.

title: Outreach missions at Houston
description: Church members travel to Houston to conduct outreach, evangelism, and fellowship with Naga families.

title: Palm Sunday
description: Commemorate Jesus' triumphant entry into Jerusalem with special worship and palm branch procession.

title: Easter Sunday & Lord's Supper
description: Celebrate Christ's victorious resurrection through Scripture, song, and the sacred fellowship of the Lord's Supper.

title: Mother's Day
description: Honor mothers in our congregation with special recognition, flowers, and a message celebrating godly motherhood.

title: Executive Meeting
description: Monthly meeting of church leaders to discuss ministry plans, review finances, and coordinate upcoming activities.

title: Church Picnic & Baptism
description: A fun outdoor gathering with games, food, fellowship, and baptisms for the entire church family to relax and connect.

title: Vacation Bible School
description: A Vacation Bible School for children and members to learn about the Bible and how to apply it to their daily lives.

title: Father's Day
description: Celebrate fathers and fatherhood with special recognition, gifts, and a sermon on godly fatherhood.

title: Lord's Supper
description: A solemn observance of the Lord's Supper, remembering Christ's sacrifice and renewing our covenant with Him.

title: Homeless Ministry
description: Homeless Ministry to provide food, clothing, and shelter to the homeless in our community.

title: Half Yearly GBM
description: Mid-year General Body Meeting to review church progress, discuss upcoming initiatives, and make important decisions.

title: Fundraising & Cultural Event
description: A vibrant cultural celebration featuring traditional Naga music, dance, and cuisine to support church ministries.

title: Executive Meeting
description: Monthly leadership meeting to review church operations, plan future activities, and address administrative matters.

title: Florida Mission Trip
description: Church members travel to Florida to conduct outreach, evangelism, and fellowship with Naga families.

title: Lord's Supper
description: Quarterly observance of the Lord's Supper with special focus on remembrance and spiritual reflection.

title: Church-wide Seminar
description: Guest Speaker: Dr. Chris Shirley, Dean of Christian Education and Professor at SWBTS.

title: World Sunday School Celebration
description: A church-wide celebration of Sunday School's transformative impact—uniting worship, fellowship, and renewed commitment to teaching God's Word across every generation.

title: Fellowship with Chin Baptist Church
description: An evening of shared worship, cultural exchange, and deepening partnership with our brothers and sisters from Chin Baptist Church as one family in Christ.

title: Thanksgiving Sunday
description: A special Sunday dedicated to gratitude with special services, testimonies, and activities focusing on thankfulness to God.

title: Missions Sunday
description: Focus areas: refugees, people experiencing homelessness, and senior citizens.

title: Carol & Advent
description: An evening of carol, worship, and Scripture as we prepare our hearts for Christmas.

title: Christmas
description: A joyful celebration of Christ's birth through preaching, worship, fellowship, and feasting—welcoming all to gather and worship the Light of the World.

title: Executive Meeting
description: Year-end leadership meeting to review the year's activities, plan for the coming year, and set church goals.
